annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 1 year on 2012+ models (older models about 5,000 miles)
maint.note: Use synthetic oil that meets the VW spec for your engine. TDI diesels need the diesel spec.
Add $100–250 in parts if the rotors also need replacing.
2012 and newer Beetles may need the new battery coded to the car with a scan tool.

maint.every: About every 60,000 miles on 2014+ turbo engines; check the manual for older engines
maint.note: Not needed on TDI diesels. The 2.5L five-cylinder takes five plugs.

maint.job: Engine coolant drain and refill (VW G12/G13 type)
maint.every: Check the owner's manual; a common guide is every 30,000 miles or 5 years, and long-life VW coolant often lasts longer
maint.note: Use only VW-approved coolant; mixing types can cause sludge.
